regime.label: Short-gamma squeeze paused, not resolved - price froze at 1041.9 on half the volume while net GEX repaired 28% and the gamma flip stayed off the grid for a third session
evidence: +0.1 pts to 1041.9 is 0.01x the 7.55-pt 1-sigma daily move, the flattest session in the 13-day record, and it came one day after a 3.6-sigma -27.1-pt break - the market stalled exactly on the 1040 shelf rather than retracing it.

-1,871 baht/pt total net GEX versus -2,605 yesterday (28% shallower) but cumulative net GEX still never crosses zero anywhere in 960-1150, so there is no gamma flip in the listed grid for a third session - every strike still amplifies rather than dampens.

+0.02 pts of ATM IV (11.48 to 11.50) after a 2.53% realized gap leaves implied 2.20 pts under the 09-17 high of 13.70%: the surface still has not repriced the realized range, which is what keeps the long-vol axis structurally cheap.

S50Z26.today_summary: 1041.9 closed +0.1 pts, a 0.01-sigma session against a 7.55-pt 1-sigma daily, holding 18.1 pts (2.4 sigma) below the 1060 max-pain anchor for a second day. Volume halved to 3,036 lots from 7,172 while OI still built +686 to 13,977, and the mix inverted: +513 calls (1040 +109 on 226 lots, 1150 +78, 1100 +67) against +173 puts concentrated in the 960 tail (+145 on 218 lots). Net dealer gamma repaired from -2,605 to -1,871 baht/pt purely because call OI grew at 1040-1100 while near-money put OI at 1040 fell -47 on 173 lots - volume without an OI build, i.e. closing flow eroding the shelf price is sitting on. The pain curve is a plateau rather than a point: 1050 scores 574,670 against 1060's 578,010, only 0.6% apart, so treat 1050-1060 as the anchor band.
what_changed: Net GEX repaired 28%, -2,605 to -1,871 baht/pt, the first improvement since the 09-30 sign flip, but the gamma flip stayed absent from the 960-1150 grid for a third straight session.
Flow flipped call-side: the put/call volume ratio fell 1.15 to 0.73 and 75% of the +686 OI build was calls, versus a two-sided +4,859 build yesterday.
Volume collapsed -58% to 3,036 lots and price moved +0.1 pts - the squeeze stopped feeding itself without giving any of the 27.1 pts back.
Downside hedges rolled from near-money to the tail: 1040 put OI -47 on 173 lots of closing flow while the 960 put wall added +145 on 218 lots to 1,353, the largest single-strike OI in the series.
S50Z26.five_day_thesis: -35.8 pts (-3.32%) from 1077.7 on 09-25 and a net GEX swing of +171 to -1,871 baht/pt are the five-session frame: this series re-rated from a long-gamma, range-bound back quarter into a short-gamma accelerant and has not re-rated back. The gamma flip walked 1150 (09-25) to 1140 (09-26, 09-29) and then off the grid entirely from 09-30, so three of the last five sessions have had no dampening strike anywhere in 960-1150. Total OI nearly doubled over the window, 7,220 to 13,977 (+93.6%), which marks fresh burden being parked rather than an unwind of old positions - the Unwind zone is not in play. Max pain slid 1080 to 1060 (-20 pts) and has now sat above spot for two sessions, inverting the eight-session pattern where price led the anchor. The asymmetry that matters: ATM IV is net -0.33 pts over the five sessions (11.83 to 11.50) through a 3.3% drawdown, so implied compressed while realized expanded, and with 88 DTE there is no expiry pin and no gamma flip to act as a floor beneath the 1040 shelf.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1040 / 1000
strategies.rationale: Short gamma with no flip in the grid means a break below the 1040 shelf gets hedged WITH the move, and that shelf is now eroding (-47 OI on 173 lots of closing flow), so the defined-risk expression of continuation is a debit vertical down to the 700-lot 1000 strike rather than a fade up toward the 1050-1060 anchor band.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 13.50 pts net debit (1040P 23.00 ask - 1000P 9.50 bid), 2,700 baht at 200 baht/pt; max gain 26.50 pts at or below 1000.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above 1060 - the max-pain anchor and the top of the pain plateau - voids the continuation read.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1000 / 960
strategies.rationale: Today's only real put demand was the 960 wall taking +145 contracts on 218 lots with IV +0.40 to 13.66% - volume, OI build and an IV move together, so Vol2Vol marks it live - which makes the cheap tail leg the structurally confirmed path at a 6.7:1 payoff rather than paying up for near-money premium.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 5.30 pts net debit (1000P 10.10 ask - 960P 4.80 bid), 1,060 baht at 200 baht/pt; max gain 34.70 pts at or below 960.

strategies.name: Call credit spread 1060 / 1080
strategies.rationale: The counterweight if the stall becomes a drift back up: the short strike sits exactly on the 1060 max-pain anchor 18.1 pts above spot with 526 call OI and 165 lots, covered by the live 714-lot 1080 shelf (178 lots, +42 OI), but dealers are short gamma above as well as below, so short-vol here is negative-skew and belongs in small size, not as the core.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 14.90 pts (20-pt width - 5.10 net credit from 1060C 15.00 bid / 1080C 9.90 ask), 2,980 baht at 200 baht/pt.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1080 puts price through the short strike and the near call wall with no gamma flip above to dampen it.

S50Z26.prediction: 1041.9 is coiled, not repaired: with net GEX at -1,871 baht/pt and no gamma flip in 960-1150, the base case is that the next 7.55-pt move extends rather than mean-reverts, and the 1040 shelf losing OI on closing flow tilts that path down toward 1000 and the 1,353-lot 960 wall. A reclaim and close above 1060 - the max-pain anchor, the top of the 1050-1060 pain plateau, and the level that would need the call-side OI build at 1040-1100 to be real demand rather than overwriting - invalidates the downside read. Watch the gamma flip re-entering the 960-1150 grid as the signal that dealers have stopped amplifying; until then, 11.50% ATM IV against a 2.53% realized gap keeps the long-vol axis the cheaper side of the matrix.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no instruction to execute anything. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker here than for share-settled single stocks: treat the 1050-1060 max-pain band as a tendency, not a magnet, and note that at 88 DTE there is no expiry pin at all. Defined-risk is not risk-free - every max loss quoted above is a real outcome, short-vol payoffs are negative-skew, and a macro or news shock can overrun the whole option structure regardless of where OI sits.
